project_type: TypeScript monorepo - multi-source music aggregator with NestJS backend
build_system: pnpm workspaces, tsc for individual packages
verification_instructions: pnpm run lint, pnpm run typecheck, pnpm run build, pnpm run test
contribution_requirements: Conventional Commits, ESLint + Prettier, strict TypeScript
key_patterns: ConnectorRegistry interface defined in packages/shared/src/connectors/interfaces.ts. MusicConnector interface defined there too. ConnectorManifest in types.ts. Connector packages at packages/connectors/{yandex-music,youtube-music,file-import} are stubs. ConnectedService model in Prisma with status enum. TokenVaultService for token encryption. RedisService for state storage.
directory_structure: apps/api/src/ modules: auth, audit, common, config, health, kms, prisma, redis, token-vault
